tagline: Users are the scraping network. Intercept, transform, publish, earn.
referral_rule: The referrer earns referral_pct % of the platform commission generated by each node that signed up with their referral code (bonus on top: the referred node keeps its full net; platform keeps the rest). At commission_pct=10 + referral_pct=20, a referrer earns 2% of referred gross.
llm_note: Slot for an LLM: POST recipe fn + failing sample to llm_model_endpoint to rewrite selectors. Empty = rule-based refiner only. Set endpoint in needs.json, server passes it through at /api/refine (field llm_available).

free.note: Free: 100 metered API calls/day + 1 published dataset. Enough to try every endpoint.

pro.note: $9/mo. ARS-friendly: pay with any international card via Stripe; if your card is rejected, use the manual checkout below and activate over DM — same price, human-approved.

tiers_doc: Metered reads: GET /api/public/* + GET /api/records count against the caller's day bucket (UTC, data/usage.json). Token requests count per node; anonymous browser reads share the 'anon' bucket; bot/CI user-agents (curl, urllib, probes) are exempt so monitors never trip the paywall. Publish cap: free tier may publish 1 dataset, pro 50.
stripe_doc: LEGACY slot (auto-migrates to data/secrets.json 0600 on read). Paste keys via the Owner drawer instead: POST /api/owner/keys. Empty = manual checkout (contact-to-activate, intent logged, human flips the tier). With a secret stored, the provider flips live to real Stripe Checkout Sessions (stdlib urllib, no SDK); the webhook secret lets POST /api/stripe-webhook verify signatures and flip tiers automatically. Never commit real keys; never touch real money without the owner.
support_doc: Manual checkout target: the buyer is sent here with a pre-filled activation request; the intent is logged to data/intents.jsonl and a human approves within 24h.
referral_payout_note: Honest MPC: referral credit accrues live on /api/leaderboard, but money movement stays human-approved — credit becomes payable once it passes referral_payout_threshold SCRAPE, then the owner reviews the referred records for spam and pays out manually (wallet on file in the ledger). No auto-payouts.
test_node_patterns_doc: fnmatch patterns marking a signup as test:true (agent/test traffic). Test nodes are excluded from public earnings/leaderboard/published by default (?include_test=1 audits them) and are the ONLY rows POST /api/nodes/purge-test deletes. Prod names must never match these.
growth_channel_doc: Poster backend: dryrun (default: logs exactly what WOULD post to data/outbox.jsonl, zero accounts needed) or x_api (POSTs via X API v2 when the bearer key below is set). Owner pastes the key once, then flips this to x_api.
growth_auto_approve_doc: true = queue ships approved, scheduler posts daily with zero taps. false = owner approves each post via POST /api/growth/approve {id} (token-authed) or the dashboard Growth card.
x_bearer_token_doc: LEGACY slot (auto-migrates to data/secrets.json 0600 on read). Paste via the Owner drawer instead: POST /api/owner/keys. Empty = dryrun only; nothing is ever posted without this key. Never served via /api/config, never invent or commit a value here.
growth_interval_doc: Scheduler tick period for bin/growth.sh daemon (default: daily).
spawn_doc: BUSINESS SPAWNER: POST /api/businesses/spawn {niche | idea_id} (token-authed, strict token, no legacy carve-out) composes dataset scaffold -> recipe (via generate) -> publish (tier cap enforced) -> free tier + pro upsell -> 7 niche growth posts with ?ref=<owner code> -> owner referral code. Rate cap spawn_max_per_hour per owner. DELETE /api/businesses/<id> (owner only) unpublishes, removes recipe + owner seed rows, dequeues posts.
owner_token_doc: Master token for the Owner drawer + /api/owner/* (auto-generated on first boot). Paste it into the Owner drawer to unlock X/Stripe keys, tier prices, channel flip, growth approvals, and payout review. NEVER served by any API, never committed with a real value.
secrets_doc: 0600 vault for pasted secrets (x_bearer_token, stripe_secret, stripe_webhook_secret). Written only via POST /api/owner/keys; values are never echoed by any GET.
decisions_doc: Append-only owner decisions: growth approvals live in data/growth.json; payout/intent approve+reject rows land here (kind=intent|payout, by=owner). Leaderboard payout_status turns paid/rejected from these rows.
gaps_path_doc: Append-only loop backlog: the e082 keep-going loop files a gap row per stalled tick via POST /api/gaps (source e082-loop). Public reads; node/owner-token writes; test rows hide by default.
collect_interval_doc: REAL-DATA collector tick period for bin/collect.sh daemon (default 30min). Respects upstream rate limits: one small fetch per tick per source; failures back off and serve cache, never hammer.
collect_sources_doc: REAL public no-key sources, fetched with stdlib urllib (browser UA, 20s timeout, <=3 tries with backoff). crypto: CoinGecko simple/price first, fallback Coinbase spot then Kraken ticker (first live answer wins; the winning origin is stored per row as source). fiat: open.er-api.com USD latest (free, no key). Every ingested row carries source + fetched_at so anyone can re-pull the same fact and match it.
collector_doc: Prod (test:false) system node that ingests collector rows. Datasets: crypto-spot (BTC/ETH USD), usd-fx (USD/EUR, USD/GBP, USD/JPY). Published snapshots rebuild on every successful tick.
